evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies RPC argument handling and responses in src/rpc/fees.cpp, src/rpc/mempool.cpp, and src/rpc/net.cpp.
rationale: Addressing client workarounds for unit conversion solves a long-standing gap in Core's RPC interface. Downstream tooling almost universally operates in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB, and manually converting introduces precision issues in sub-1 sat/vB environments.
